newsitem.title: CHINA: China sells 13 mln black and white TV sets in '96.
newsitem.headline: China sells 13 mln black and white TV sets in '96.

text.p: China produced nearly 15 million black and white television sets in 1996 and sold more than 13 million, up by 15 percent compared with 1995, the Beijing Youth Daily said on Thurday.
Rural areas remained the main market for black and white televisions, accounting for about 50 percent of all sales with the rest going for export, it said.
Domestic demand for black and white televisions in 1997 was estimated at 6-7 million sets, it said.
In 1995, China produced 13 million black and white sets and sold 11 million, the newspaper said quoting figures from the Ministry of Electronics Industry.
